2608.25479.title: 4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control
2608.25479.paper_summary: Generative video models now synthesize footage nearly indistinguishable from reality. Their promise as interactive tools hinges on fine-grained control of how objects and the camera move over time, yet each existing approach captures only part of this: camera-parameter methods steer the viewpoint but cannot move objects, 2D-trajectory methods act in the image plane and ignore depth and occlusion, and recent 3D methods add geometry but run only offline at a fixed length. In particular, none combines 3D-consistent control of both camera and objects with real-time, streaming generation. Here we show that camera motion, object trajectories, and depth can be unified into a single 3D point-track representation, from which one model performs joint camera and object control, depth editing, and motion transfer in a single forward pass. To learn this interface at scale, we mine in-the-wild video for 3D motion supervision, yielding OpenVidHD-Motion3D, and encode it with a lightweight Geometric Motion Head that plugs into a pretrained video diffusion model. Because this encoder is temporally separable, we distill the model into a causal streaming student that generates arbitrarily long video in four denoising steps at memory independent of length. This unified design surpasses prior camera-only, 2D, and offline-3D methods in motion-control precision while covering modalities they address only in isolation. 4DStreamCtrl runs at 20 FPS on a single high-end GPU for 480p video and stays temporally coherent over hundreds of frames, enabling, to our knowledge, interactive 4D-controllable streaming generation for the first time. More broadly, grounding generation in explicit 3D geometry with efficient causal inference points toward interactive world models with closed-loop spatiotemporal control, from controllable simulators to real-time visual imagination for embodied agents.
2608.25479.paper_summary_zh: 生成視頻模型現在合成的影像幾乎無法與現實區分開來。它們作為互動工具的潛力依賴於對物體和相機隨時間移動的細緻控制，但現有的每種方法僅捕捉到這一部分：相機參數方法引導視點但無法移動物體，2D軌跡方法在影像平面上運作且忽略深度和遮擋，而最近的3D方法增加了幾何形狀但僅在固定長度下離線運行。特別是，沒有一種方法能將相機和物體的3D一致控制與實時流生成結合在一起。在這裡，我們展示了相機運動、物體軌跡和深度可以統一為單一的3D點追踪表示，從中一個模型在單次前向傳遞中執行聯合相機和物體控制、深度編輯和運動轉移。為了在大規模上學習這個接口，我們從野外視頻中挖掘3D運動監督，產生了OpenVidHD-Motion3D，並用輕量級的幾何運動頭進行編碼，該頭可以接入預訓練的視頻擴散模型。由於這個編碼器在時間上是可分離的，我們將模型提煉成一個因果流學生，該學生在四個去噪步驟中生成任意長度的視頻，並且記憶與長度無關。這種統一設計在運動控制精度上超越了先前的僅相機、2D和離線3D方法，同時涵蓋了它們僅孤立處理的模態。4DStreamCtrl在單個高端GPU上以20 FPS運行480p視頻，並在數百幀中保持時間一致性，使我們首次實現了互動的4D可控流生成。更廣泛地說，將生成基於明確的3D幾何形狀與高效的因果推斷相結合，指向具有閉環時空控制的互動世界模型，從可控模擬器到具身體代理的實時視覺想像。
